name: MyDeputy AI Chat & Booking
author: MyDeputy

sections.description:
MyDeputy is an enterprise-grade AI Chatbot and Smart Booking Terminal trained exclusively on your business data. Add a beautiful chat widget to your WordPress or WooCommerce site and let it handle customer questions, lead generation, and appointment bookings — 24/7, in 95+ languages.

✅ 14-day free trial — no credit card required. After your trial, choose a plan that fits your business. Not satisfied? Cancel anytime in one click, no questions asked.

🤖 AI Chatbot

  • One-click setup — Install the plugin, connect your account, and the AI is live. The entire setup takes less than 2 minutes.
  • Automatic website scan — MyDeputy reads and learns from all content on your site automatically. No manual input needed.
  • Trained on your content — Point the AI at your website, upload a PDF, or send a voice memo via WhatsApp or Telegram. It learns instantly.
  • Train via Messengers — Upload files or send updates directly from WhatsApp or Telegram to keep your chatbot’s knowledge always up to date.
  • Handles any question — FAQs, product info, pricing, opening hours — all answered instantly without human involvement.
  • Speaks 95+ languages — Automatically detects and replies in your visitor’s language.
  • WooCommerce ready — Syncs with your store to help visitors discover and choose products.

📅 Smart Booking Terminal

  • Real-time bookings — When a visitor books through the chat widget, the request instantly appears on your team’s shared Booking Terminal (tablet/desktop).
  • Messenger notifications — New bookings and leads are delivered directly to your WhatsApp or Telegram — no need to constantly check a dashboard.
  • Unlimited staff — Your entire team can manage bookings from one shared terminal simultaneously.
  • Any business type — Restaurants, salons, clinics, gyms, consultants — any service business works out of the box.

📊 Analytics & Reports

  • Get booking stats and conversion reports sent directly to Telegram or WhatsApp.
  • Monitor your chatbot performance from the embedded mini-dashboard inside WordPress Admin.

External services

This plugin connects to the MyDeputy cloud service (https://mydeputy.co.uk) to deliver AI chat and booking functionality.

Data sent to the service includes: site URL, site token, administrator email, and visitor chat/booking messages — but only after the administrator explicitly enables consent in plugin settings and clicks “Connect MyDeputy”.

Your data, your rules. You can request complete deletion of all your data from MyDeputy servers at any time — simply disconnect the plugin or contact our support team. No data is retained after deletion.

For full details, please review our Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, and Pricing.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin directly from the WordPress plugin screen, or upload to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it through the Plugins screen.
  3. Open the MyDeputy menu in your WordPress Admin.
  4. Enable the External Services consent checkbox and click Save Settings.
  5. Click Connect MyDeputy to create or link your account.
  6. Enable the chat widget — your AI assistant is live!
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

The plugin itself is free and open source. It connects to the MyDeputy cloud service, which includes a 14-day free trial. After the trial you can choose a paid plan. No credit card required to start.

Is this trialware?

No. There is no locked premium code inside this plugin. All features are provided by the MyDeputy cloud platform.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes! The AI automatically syncs with your product catalog to recommend items and answer product-specific questions.

Can I train the AI on my own content?

Absolutely. You can train the AI by pointing it at your website URL, uploading a PDF, or even sending files via WhatsApp or Telegram — the system processes them instantly.

Does the plugin collect data without my knowledge?

No. All external connections are disabled until the administrator explicitly enables consent and clicks “Connect MyDeputy” in the plugin settings.

Can my whole team use the Booking Terminal?

Yes. The Booking Terminal supports unlimited staff members and can be accessed from any device simultaneously.

  • Replaced iframe embedding with a native wp-admin mini-dashboard.
  • Security improvements: strict input sanitization and validation for all proxy requests.
  • Added logo and banner assets to the WordPress plugin directory.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
